name: xero-official
description: Connect Workspace to Xero's official hosted MCP server. Read and write Xero accounting data: organisation settings, contacts, invoices, credit notes, bank transactions, payments, manual journals and the P&L, balance sheet, trial balance and aged reports. Sign in with your Xero login; no Xero developer app needed.

branding.tagline: Xero's own hosted MCP server, one-click sign-in

listing.longDescription:
**Xero Official** connects Workspace to Xero's own hosted MCP server at `api.xero.com/mcp/v1`, so Claude can work with your Xero data directly through Xero.

Click **Connect**, sign in with your Xero login and choose which organisations to share. mySMB's registered Xero app handles the sign-in, so you never need to create an app in the Xero developer portal.

Xero's server has 39 Accounting tools: it can read organisation settings, contacts, invoices, credit notes, items, quotes, bank transactions, payments, manual journals, tracking categories and the profit and loss, balance sheet, trial balance and aged reports, and it can create and update records. Agents should confirm with you before anything is written to Xero.
highlights: One-click Connect, no Xero developer app needed
Contacts, invoices, bank transactions, payments, journals and core reports
Agents confirm before writing to Xero

connection.instructions: Click Connect and sign in with your Xero login, then choose the organisations to share. If your workspace has not been set up with mySMB's Xero app yet, register an app in the Xero developer portal, add the redirect URL shown above, and paste its Client ID and Secret below.
